## Verdict: CLEAN - merge-ready

First review of this PR. Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4449#issuecomment-7228937769

Trial merge: PR head `0f816e13c8804f226631b73f8ad014bb92be28e1` merged with upstream/main `e80c70942c9484e22d4dfa2110590473a5e49875`. The merge has no conflicts. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

## What the PR changes

- `xtask/src/unit_env/config.rs:97`: the test builds three expected paths with one `join` for each component. Before, `join(".cargo/config.toml")` kept the `/` separator on Windows. `notes()` builds the path as `parent.join(".cargo")` and then `dir.join(name)` (lines 12 and 38). On Windows, `display()` then gives `\`. The new expected paths use the same construction as the runtime code, so the string match is now correct on all platforms.
- The four path-count assertions, the five key-hint assertions and the two privacy assertions do not change. The runtime code does not change. The `#[test]` count does not change.
- `docs/decisions/4426-windows-config-paths.md`: the decision record is present and complete (decided, why, before reading, dropped, cost).

## Safety tier

Not a safety-tier review. The PR changes one test assertion in `xtask`. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. No goldens move. No `crates/ui` change, so no screenshots are necessary.
